Walls are painted, floor is tile/ceramic, ceiling is exposed concrete and the bathroom is still red-brick unfinished, so it's ready for the renter's own finishing/fit-out. The layout suits a general office for about 7 desks and also suits a legal office with a private office plus reception/waiting. Rent 8,500 EGP, available from Oct 27, 2026.

units.summary_en: Bare-shell semifinished office of about 26 m² on the 5th floor in New Cairo for 11,000 EGP/month. It has a main street-facing room with large glass front plus a small inner room and 1 red-brick bathroom shell with a high shaft window. White-painted walls, ceramic tile floor, unfinished concrete ceiling, bright natural light from 2 windows, no doors yet and construction leftovers – ready for your own finishing/fit-out. The layout suits an office for about 5 desks (you bring your own desks) and also suits a law office with reception plus private room. Available from 2026-10-27.
